sn22.48:1.2: “Grasping” is so central to the concept of the five aggregates that we rarely find the “bare” aggregates mentioned as here. The five aggregates are not presented as a catch-all category that encompasses all of reality, but rather five types of phenomena that provoke attachment, forming the basis of what we take to be “self”. Desire is what drives the formation of attachment, but it requires all the aggregates to function. Thus the “grasping” aggregates are numbered “five” after the model of the hand that grasps.
